body:
Good morning, Bakersfield. It’s Saturday, August 22, 2026, and we’re starting the day with a high of 100° and air quality at a moderate 74 AQI. Overnight, a shooting at a Taco Bell in east Bakersfield and a fire at a vacant house on King Street were the most serious incidents. Today’s top story is the arrest of a 15-year-old suspect in connection to the deadly shooting at Independence High School’s football game last night. Let’s get you caught up on what happened while you slept.

## The Kern Overnight

The night’s most serious call came just after midnight, when a witness reported seeing someone shot at a Taco Bell in the Baker Street area. Officers broadcast an officer-safety alert and described the suspect as a white male in his 40s to 50s, wearing a black shirt and dark pants, sitting inside a white vehicle — possibly a Ford Explorer. Before that, around 2:16 a.m., flames were visible inside a vacant single-story house on King Street with heavy smoke showing. Multiple engines and a truck company responded, and the fire was under control by about 2:25. Just before 11 p.m., a two-vehicle collision left one vehicle on fire near Gosford Road and Harris Road. Engine 14 and Engine 9 responded — one car was smoking with another about a quarter mile back — and command dubbed it the Harris Incident. Injuries from that collision are unknown. Multiple reports of a grass fire drew a large response — engines, patrol units, a water tender, a dozer and a helicopter — to southbound Highway 395 north of Brown Road. Crews found a small roadside fire that was quickly extinguished, and the extra equipment was canceled. Around 10:38 p.m., an assault with a knife was reported with no injuries. The suspect — about 6 feet tall with neck tattoos, wearing black shorts, a gray shirt and white shoes — fled on foot northbound.

## Today's weather

Expect a high near 100° and a low around 74° tonight. It’s currently 97° at Meadows Field (KBFL). No active weather alerts are in effect for Kern County. Air quality is 74 — moderate. There are no active fires to report.

## Top stories

**KGET 17 reports that Bakersfield Mayor Karen Goh has released a statement on the deadly shooting at Independence High School.** In her remarks, Mayor Goh expressed her shock and sadness over the tragic incident that occurred during a football game. She emphasized that the safety of our children and community is her top priority and that the city is working closely with law enforcement to ensure justice is served. The mayor urged anyone with information to come forward and help the investigation.

**According to 23ABC, officials have announced the arrest of a 15-year-old suspect in connection to the deadly shooting at Independence High School’s football game.** The arrest was made Saturday morning in the 7500 block of Stockdale Highway. No other arrests have been announced and no other suspects have been identified at this time. The investigation is ongoing.

**Bakersfield Now tells us that Southwest Market has canceled its Saturday event at Independence High School after last night’s fatal shooting.** Organizers made the decision out of respect for the victim and the community’s need to process the tragedy. The event will not be rescheduled.

## Something good

A local family is organizing a flea market to support Villafana’s need for a prosthetic leg. The event aims to raise $8,900 for this important cause. It’s a heartwarming reminder of how our community comes together to help one another.

## Coming up this week

Tonight, Saturday, August 22, 2026, Los Yonic’s Zamacona, Los caminantes, y Grupo Yndio will perform at the Fox Theater. On Tuesday, August 24, 2026, the Fox Theater will offer a Cults & Classics: Season Pass for 2026-2027. Rodney Carrington is scheduled to perform at the Fox Theater on Thursday, August 27, 2026. On Friday, August 28, 2026, CUMBIATRON: THE CUMBIA RAVE will take place at the Fox Theater. And on Saturday, August 29, 2026, Willie Barcena and Michael Return Of The King Tribute Featuring Michael Phoenix will both perform at the Fox Theater.

On Wednesday, August 26, 2026, there will be a Special City Council Meeting at 12:00 p.m., followed by a City Council Meeting at 3:30 p.m. and another at 5:15 p.m.
